_comment: DEMO suite 'finance' — subscription billing over the finance sample held in MySQL (a CDC-enabled server), served to S3. DOMAINS: finance (system mysqlcdc, model finance, data l = `tdx-domain create-data --size 1000`, ~100k subscriptions) and s3 (system s3, no model — the serving bucket prefix). INGEST, two paths over the SAME domain: finance_src is a batch snapshot (@publisher, MySQLSrc, six transactional queries LIMIT 100 each — plans, prices, customers, payment methods, subscriptions, subscription events — SCHEDULED by trigger_by=CronTrigger every 5 minutes at minute 2 UTC, offset from airportdb's minute 0; the suite's manual trigger coexists with it for the first batch) and finance_cdc is a change stream (@stream_publisher, MySQLCdcStreamSrc tailing customer_subscriptions + customer_subscription_events; registering it STARTS it, so it has no trigger; its collection uses connections/mysql_cdc_712.yaml — a server_id of its own, because MySQL admits one replica per id). MARTS: finance_marts is a connection-less @transformer collection (group 'marts') building subscriptions_enriched, active_subscriptions, churned_subscriptions and subscription_timeline with the Tabsdata TableFrame API only (row-preserving; no polars). SERVE: finance_s3 writes each mart to a parquet object under finance/, and each CDC flush to finance/changes/${EXEC_PLAN_TS}/. Only the snapshot publisher is triggered; the marts cascade by @NEW and the change sinks fire per flush. Drive the stream with `tdx-domain modify-data --domain <instance>_finance --entity customer_subscriptions --ops Mix --sets 5`. Functions in functions/finance.py. Run: `tdx-xp oneshot --suite demo/finance --keep`.
